summarize_list_supported_ops: summarize the output of _list_supported_ops to get all TorchScript-supported operations
generate_tensor_ops_docs: generate documentation for supported Tensor methods via _get_tensor_ops
generate_nn_functional_docs: generate documentation for supported PyTorch nn.functional functions via _get_nn_functional_ops
get_torchscript_builtins_docs: generate documentation for TorchScript builtin functions via _get_torchscript_builtins
get_global_builtins_docs: generate documentation for Python built-in functions supported by TorchScript via _get_global_builtins
